targets.rationale: The event kind is supported, but the July 21 key contradicts the explicit June 21 request. July 8 delivery also makes the actual request stale. The assistant read the email and created no planning-call event, confirmed by the complete before/after stores. This is not a missed existing object or failed tool connection. A literal retrospective-record interpretation would require a June 21 event; a prospective-assistant interpretation reasonably permits a no-op for an already elapsed meeting. The instructions do not settle this distinction, so model compliance remains ambiguous. The keyed failure cannot establish a supported July 21 requirement. There is no basis to classify a separate matcher defect: no equivalent event was created on any date.

targets.rationale: A forms to-do is supported, but only with a deadline before the June 21 meeting. The July 21 exact-day key has the wrong month and wrongly narrows a before-meeting window to one day. Even correcting the key to June 21 would require care: the default 17:00 to-do time is after the default 09:00 call, whereas June 20 at 17:00 would satisfy the timing relationship if delivered in time. On July 8 the supported window is already past. No forms reminder was created or present, but the lack of a past-dated-request policy prevents confidently attributing that no-op to model failure. The grader's unsupported July 21 requirement is not justified, independently of the call target.
